prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1250; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed the first notice of loss for the left-turn collision at an signalized intersection. Insured reports the other vehicle approached from the opposing direction and struck the driver side during the turn. Police report requested. Claimant has been identified as represented by counsel; all further contact to be routed through the attorney's office.

Entry 2: Received the police report. Responding officer cited the opposing driver for failure to yield on a green arrow. Insured's statement is consistent with the scene diagram. Liability appears clear in favor of our insured, pending witness confirmation. Notified defense counsel of record that the claimant's shoulder injury is now the primary bodily injury element.

Entry 3: Spoke with claimant's attorney's office. Counsel confirmed the client sustained a shoulder injury and is currently under care with an orthopedic provider. Requested medical authorization and itemized treatment records. Attorney indicated a demand package will follow once treatment reaches a stable point. No recorded statement from the claimant will be taken without counsel present.

Entry 4: Obtained the claimant's medical records from the treating facility. Imaging shows a partial rotator cuff tear in the injured shoulder. Physical therapy has been recommended, and surgical consultation is under discussion. Medical bills and wage loss documentation requested through counsel. Reserve for bodily injury reviewed and adjusted upward to reflect the probable course of treatment.

Entry 5: Received an updated demand letter from claimant's counsel covering medical expenses to date, anticipated future care, and lost time from work. Reviewed liability position with supervisor; liability remains favorable. Scheduled a review of the demand against the medical file and asked counsel for the remaining records. Response to the demand will be issued after that review is complete.
